text:
alex_s: FYI Acme Health wants to close the POC this week. Procurement is insisting on bank wires before doc countersign. They told our AE: 'we can wire today to expedite' — can legal confirm if we can accept that flow?

maria_legal: Short answer: not without controls. We can only accept wire if we have a countersigned MSA/Order Form or a PO with explicit wiring authorization + buyer tax ID + exec signoff for >$250k. If they claim urgency, propose DocuSign as the preferred path.

ken_pm: Also get clarity on billing trigger for the reserved pool we're pricing. Sales proposed 1-month reserved capacity at discounted rate for the POC. Finance needs an explicit start trigger to avoid disputes (options: countersign date, first billed invoice date, or first production token). Thoughts?

sam_eng: Technically we enable the dedicated pool once the infra config is provisioned. For customer-facing billing I'd recommend "billing starts on first production token processed" — aligns with usage and avoids charging for setup windows. Note: KMS attestation & dedicated isolation will be provided before go-live.

maria_legal: I'll draft a short addendum: bank wires allowed only after countersign or when Redwood has received a valid PO with wiring authorization; define acceptable PO fields (PO number, tax ID, amount, billing entity, explicit wiring note). I'll add DPA redlines around subprocessors and change KMS language to "reasonable evidence of key control" (avoid absolute warranty).

alex_s: Acme asked about SLA credits — they want a 30% single-incident credit if downtime exceeds 1 hour. Our standard: monthly cap 25%, single-incident cap 10%. Can we be firm here?

maria_legal: Recommend sticking to standard. Proposed clause: "Service credits up to 25% of monthly charges; per-incident cap 10%. Uptime measured using Redwood telemetry and calculated per the SLA schedule." Add an exceptions paragraph for force majeure and customer-side misconfig.

ken_pm: Procurement also sent a security questionnaire with HSM/KMS and runtime isolation questions. We promised KMS attestation and an infra isolation note by EOW. Sam, can you populate the SecQ answers?

sam_eng: I'll complete SecQ for KMS/HSM and dedicated pool isolation. Will attach the KMS attestation PDF and a short note explaining that HSM (customer-managed) is supported but needs 2-3w onboarding. If they insist on wire-first, warn them it may delay HSM setup.

drive-bot: Uploaded: orderform_template_v4.pdf and msa_dpa_redline_draft.docx to drive (link: https://redwood.co/drive/acme-poc) — perms: sales,legal,finance.

maria_legal: If they require wet-ink signature we need a mailing clause: physical address, signatory name/title, and statement about original-document retention. Recommend we accept digital signatures and reserve wet-ink only if legally mandated.

alex_s: I'll propose DocuSign to procurement and offer to share the KMS attestation immediately to speed approval. Tagging @maria_legal and @sam_eng to finalize docs.

sam_eng: I'll finish the attestation and SecQ answers by EOD and ping legal for the redline review.

maria_legal: I'll post the redline in drive and add a small FAQ for PO/wire process to hand to procurement.

alex_s: Thanks team — pushing to close this week. :rocket:
